content.title: Why is Bill Murray at UCLA vs UConn basketball game in 2026 March Madness?
content.text: Bill Murray has become a UConn basketball mainstay as fan, especially during March Madness.The actor has been a constant fixture behind the bench, cheering on his son's team throughout the Huskies' NCAA Tournament runs over the last several seasons.That continued on March 22 in Philadelphia, as UConn faced UCLA in the NCAA Tournament second round.Why is Bill Murray at UCLA vs. UConn?Murray is rooting on UConn, as he has since 2021 when his son Luke Murray became an assistant under Danny Hurley.Bill Murray was in stands for the Huskies' two NCAA Tournament title runs in 2023 and 2024, as UConn became the first program since Florida in 2007 to go back-to-back.Who is Luke Murray?Luke Murray, 40, has been an assistant for nearly two decades in college basketball.He worked his way up coaching ladder, from being a graduate assistant at Arizona to stops as an assistant with Wagner, Towson and Rhode Island.Bill Murray was also in attendance for games at Luke Murray's previous stops, including Xavier (2015-2018) and Louisville (2018-2021).Bill Murray was an Illinois fan firstBill Murray attended Regis University in Denver as a pre-med student, dropping out after a year per the Denver Post.He grew up in Evanston, Illinois, and grew up a fan of the University of Illinois. He attended games during Illinois' 2005 Final Four run.Bill Murray is also a long-time Chicago Cubs fan.This article originally appeared on Nashville Tennessean: Bill Murray attends UCLA basketball vs UConn game in March Madness
